Name: Live Metrics for PostHog
Author: OG Innovations
Description: Show live values from your PostHog insights on your Stream Deck keys. Paste an insight's address, and the key displays its current number, refreshed automatically, with an optional trend sparkline. Press a key to refresh it on demand. Not affiliated with or endorsed by PostHog.

Actions.Name: Insight Value
Actions.Tooltip: Display the current value of a PostHog insight, refreshed automatically.
